_note: Optional side missions started from a crew member's dialogue. Rewards go through the engine (morale) and the trust store; the teamwork score reads morale, so no separate scoring hook is added.

items.title: A photo from outside
items.brief: Lin wants a photo: visit the Airlock on a calm turn
items.followUp: I got the picture on the long-range link. Earth saw it live. Thank you, really.

items.title: The missing message
items.brief: Omar asks you to check the comms log at the Comms station
items.followUp: You found it! A friendly ham operator saying hello. Made my week.

items.title: Two quiet turns
items.brief: Sana needs quiet: keep her off the EVA for 2 turns
items.followUp: Thank you for the quiet days. My forecast improved by one whole decimal. I am thrilled.

items.title: Maya's plant experiment
items.brief: Visit the Science bench 3 turns in a row to watch Maya's plant
items.followUp: It sprouted! Right in front of us! I named it Basil Armstrong.

items.title: The power walk-round
items.brief: Bilal wants you at the Power panel two turns in a row
items.followUp: Thanks for the walk-round. You noticed the thing with the third fuse. Sharp eye.

items.title: The great spares count
items.brief: Kofi asks you to visit the Repair station on a calm turn
items.followUp: The count matches the spreadsheet! First time ever. I am not crying, you are crying.
